title: Wellspring Lake
wikitext:
[[Image:Wellspring Lake.jpg|thumb|Wellspring Lake]]
'''Wellspring Lake''' is a small lake northeast of [[Darnassus]] and southeast of [[The Oracle Glade]] in [[Teldrassil]]. Fed by a natural spring deep within the land of the World Tree, this small lake is drained by the [[Wellspring River]].  Previously a favored spot for [[night elven]] [[fishing|fishermen]], the lake is now the home of corrupted [[timberling]]s. The surrounding area is also a dangerous place, as [[nightsaber]]s and [[spider]]s infest the landscape.
